conditional_upper_to_lower_bound.interpretation: Conditional favorable running upper peak to subsequent adverse lower maximum; within-bar upper is permitted to precede same-bar lower for a conservative bound. Joint interasset extrema and intrabar path/order are unknown. This is a possible worst-case bound, not observed historical DD or a realized trajectory. It also must not be confused with the lower-to-lower envelope excursion percentages.
